newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close higher in trendless market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close higher in trendless market.

text.p: Swedish shares closed firmer on Tuesday, boosted by drugs major Astra rising ahead of its six month earnings due out on Friday this week but lacking any strong direction.
The Stockholm bourse's general index closed 0.7 percent higher at 3,162.77 in fairly average turnover of 3.62 billion crowns.
"It was a quiet market with no strong direction," said one broker. "Swedish institutions were very passive today."
Astra was up four crowns at 149.5 ahead of the company posting its six-month report on Friday.
"The share has been depressed and people have started speculating ahead of the report on Friday," said one broker.
The other market heavyweight, telecoms group Ericsson came off morning highs to close 1.5 higher at 355.5.

Forestry group Stora ended one higher at 132.5 crowns after releasing a stronger than expected six-month result and painting a brighter future for the rest of the year. It posted a profit after financial items of 1.22 billion crowns against expectations of 1.13 billion crowns.
Investment group Investor AB rose 5.5 to 421 crowns even though co-owned Saab Auto posted a first half loss.
As expected, Saab Auto drove deeper into the red, posting a loss of 600 million against a loss of 428 million a year ago, partly due to development and marketing costs.
Beverage group Spendrups slid 3.5 crowns to 56 on news PepsiCo was ending its distribution agreement in the year 2001 and join forces with Norwegian-Swedish beverage maker Pripps Ringnes.
